# Pinned ERC-8505 reference reader

Unmodified `assets/erc-8505/work-records.mjs` from
https://github.com/kurokawasato/ERCs/tree/9f49fb912aad69c94e1103c327e6300b436c408c
(the head of ethereum/ERCs#2185 checked on 28 November 2026).

ERC assets are released under CC0-1.0, as the draft's copyright section states.
The `supplemented` step in `src/work-records-supplemented.mjs` calls this code and
does not change it. The test suite verifies the SHA-256 pin.
